clIoU_adapt_LOFO_note: This key was named clIoU_adapt_ODS, but 0.2848 is the LOFO figure in expanded_bench.json, not the OIS one (0.2960). ODS and OIS are oracle protocols that pick a threshold using the labels; LOFO does not. Nothing reads this key -- it is provenance -- but a protocol name on the wrong number is the kind of thing that gets quoted.
quantile_note: 99 for WHOLE FRAMES (median clIoU_adapt 0.1514, +0.0199 vs q98, 31/38 wins, p=9.9e-05, over-predicting frames 9/38 -> 6/38). On the label-centred TILES the optimum was 98 (0.2848 vs 0.2450) -- tiles contain proportionally more crack, so they tolerate a fatter cut. Whole-frame is the deployment setting.
